WITH AlbumRates AS (
    SELECT AlbumId, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS Rate, COUNT(*) AS TrackCount
    FROM Track
    GROUP BY AlbumId
),
MeanRate AS (
    SELECT AVG(Rate) AS MeanRate
    FROM AlbumRates
)
SELECT AVG(AlbumRates.Rate) AS AverageRate,
       AVG(AlbumRates.TrackCount) AS AverageTrackCount,
       AVG(AlbumRates.Rate - MeanRate.MeanRate) AS AverageExcess
FROM AlbumRates
CROSS JOIN MeanRate
WHERE AlbumRates.Rate > MeanRate.MeanRate;
